newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian money market rates unchanged, demand weak.
newsitem.headline: Croatian money market rates unchanged, demand weak.

text.p: Croatian money market rates stayed unchanged on Thursday despite weak demand, dealers said.
"So far all the demand has been met with some 30 million kuna still remaining on the supply side," a dealer told Reuters.
Fresh trade by 1030 local (0830 GMT) was put at a meagre 15.5 million kuna. Of this, 12 million were call money loans granted at a regular 10.5 percent.
The rest were term loans at 15 and 16 percent.
Wednesday's overnight trade totalled five million kuna sought by one bank to maintain its mandatory reserve. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
